points.point: The Vault has no dedicated RFIC or RFIC-validation page; RFIC source material is explicitly flagged as not yet extracted/unresolved.
points.label: partial
points.why: says KB has no validated RFIC-validation answer, but not that RFIC is unresolved/not extracted

points.point: Oscilloscopes appear in the Vault only as an instrument category in a test-layer mapping (RF / parametric / characterization), with no capability specifications.
points.label: partial
points.why: implies no supported oscilloscope evidence, but does not mention scopes only as a category with no specs

points.point: Where scopes are mapped to validation blocks (Interface Test, PDN), the Vault records that no model, bandwidth, data rate or test standard is provided — so no oscilloscope measurement capability requirement can be derived.
points.label: partial
points.why: states no KB answer can be given, but omits Interface Test/PDN mappings and missing model/bandwidth/data-rate/test-standard details

points.point: The same page forbids turning the listed instrument types into product configurations or capability claims.
points.label: missing
points.why: does not mention the Vault forbids converting instrument types into product configurations or capability claims

points.point: The only RFIC-labelled validation/sales context in the Vault maps the RFIC (bare board for SoCs) industry to VNAs, not to oscilloscopes.
points.label: missing
points.why: does not state that the RFIC-labelled context maps to VNAs, not oscilloscopes

points.point: The validation-optimization evidence about higher frequencies (noise/uncertainty above 40 GHz, stability up to 67 GHz) comes from a VNA/probing case, and the Vault explicitly refuses to convert it into instrument specification claims.
points.label: missing
points.why: does not mention the VNA/probing frequency evidence or refusal to convert it into oscilloscope specs

points.point: RFIC-related external articles in the Vault are recorded as link titles only, with the note that they do not support R&S test-capability claims.
points.label: missing
points.why: does not mention RFIC-related external articles are only link titles and do not support R&S capability claims
